target: retail-margin residual: actual minus expanding-window production forecast
anchor: prior-year same-quarter actual minus median of at most three earlier same-quarter actuals, including prior year; fewer than two gives zero anomaly
sequence: separate region-level capture/squeeze impulses from contemporaneous retail and wholesale changes; stocks decay by 0.8 each week; quarter feature is mean stock, weighted by production geographic weights
weekly_calendar: same complete in-quarter weekly rows as production; region states run causally across quarter boundaries; eight-transition initial warmup; internal gaps block
fit: nonnegative standardized ridge coefficients using exact active-set enumeration, alpha 2; unpenalized intercept
hyperparameter_search: NONE; no rule changes or tuning after results
limitations: weekly regional retail is not MUSA station pricing
spot wholesale is not delivered acquisition cost
static current store weights are not PIT or regional gallons
weekly weights uniform, not observed MUSA gallons
current-vintage market and outcomes; historical publication lags not reconstructed
features motivated by previously inspected misses
earliest misses cannot be tested by a correction lacking earlier residual training observations
